fluff.overview: The LCAF fields conventional infantry that benefit from the Commonwealth's deep industrial base, equipping even garrison formations with reliable, well-maintained weapons and transport. Mechanized hover platoons ride into battle aboard hovercraft that provide both speed and the ability to cross water and rough terrain without slowing, making them effective rapid-reaction forces. Armed with assault rifles and Grand Mauler infantry gauss cannons, these platoons field some of the hardest-hitting crew-served weapons available to conventional infantry, capable of threatening armored vehicles at extended range.
